 CBDT has extended the due date for filing income tax returns but this extension does not apply to all taxpayers for AY 2026-27.
 Who Is Eligible for the Extended ITR Due Date?
 The extended deadline applies only to tax audit cases, which includes:
 Companies: Companies required to file income tax returns.
 Tax Audit Cases: Non-company taxpayers whose accounts are required to be audited under the Income Tax Act or any other applicable law.
 Partners of Audit Firms: Partners of firms whose accounts are subject to audit, along with specified spouses where applicable.
 Who Is Not Covered Under the Extended Deadline?
 The following categories of taxpayers are not covered under the extended deadline are:
 Individuals and HUFs whose accounts are not required to be audited.
 Businesses and professionals whose accounts are not subject to tax audit.
 Taxpayers covered under specified international transaction reporting requirements u/s 92E.

 The extension is specifically for taxpayers covered by the specified audit category. 
 It should not be treated as a general extension for all income tax return filers. If an individual has missed filling ITR, you can file it later but penalty applies for AY 2026-27.
